headword: {影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える
reading: えいきょうをあたえる
gloss: to have an influence; to affect

definitions.gloss: to have an influence on; to affect; to impact
definitions.explanation: To exert influence or produce an effect on something or someone. Can refer to both positive and negative effects.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{気分|きぶん}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
この{政策|せいさく}は{経済|けいざい}に{大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えるだろう。
examples.english: This policy will likely have a significant impact on the economy.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}の{言動|げんどう}は{子|こ}どもの{成長|せいちょう}に{少|すく}なからず{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}えるものだ。
examples.english: Parents' words and actions inevitably have a considerable influence on their children's development.

notes:
A highly common expression combining {影響|えいきょう} (influence, effect) with {与|あた}える (to give). The person or thing being influenced takes the particle に.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- AがBに{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — A affects B / A has an influence on B

COMMON MODIFIERS:
- {大|おお}きな{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a big impact
- {悪|わる}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a bad influence
- {良|よ}い{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a good influence
- {深刻|しんこく}な{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える — to have a serious impact

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {影響|えいきょう}する — to influence (more concise but slightly less natural in many contexts)
- {影響|えいきょう}を{及|およ}ぼす — to exert influence (more formal and written)
- {左右|さゆう}する — to sway, to influence decisively

USAGE:
This is the standard way to say "to affect" or "to influence" in Japanese. The passive form {影響|えいきょう}を{受|う}ける (to be influenced, to be affected) is its natural counterpart for the receiving side.
